subject: vt-dy
title: VT.DY.------WO.EXT.PRI.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-7 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One), on the page where Braxton argues that transfer shifts are 'natural' (or unnatural) dynamics manifested on the planet — registered in three things: (1) different types of beings in society, (2) the realness that culture groups perceive each other through affinity nature, (3) the progressional spread of information manifesting in mystical terms. (C)VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) is crossed with WO-EXT-PRI (world expansion principle): the question is what vibrational dynamics produces when crossed with the world-expansion principle that Braxton positions as the cosmic-scale generative engine. The subject is fed by ACT (activism), SPT-GH (spiritual growth), and POL-DY (political dynamics). The partner WO-EXT-PRI is the structural endpoint. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the central convergence hub, with COS-P (cosmic particulars) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) feeding it from above. TR-INFO (trans-information) and MOT-DY (motivation dynamics) form the lower output chain. Structural argument: vibrational dynamics reaches world-expansion only via the time-continuum-implications central hub, fed by cosmic-particulars and progressional-continuance. The transfer-shift framework requires the time-continuum and cosmic-scale convergence; vibrational dynamics alone is structurally insufficient.
